name: Rap
overview: Scripture reminds us that the heart and desires of individuals are under the sovereign control of the Lord, who directs them as He wills (Proverbs 21:1). The wicked are characterized by evil desires and a lack of favor toward their neighbors (Proverbs 21:10), which can be reflected in the content and spirit of certain music forms such as rap and R&B. Believers are called to avoid vanity, lies, and harmful behaviors like swearing and speaking evil, instead demonstrating gentleness and meekness toward all (Proverbs 30:8; Hosea 4:2; Titus 3:2). This calls Christians to discern carefully the messages they embrace in music and to seek that which aligns with godly character and speech.
